mostWorthwhile.text: Developing red cells was most worthwhile: the picture connected a low-oxygen cue in the kidney to a signal reaching marrow, showing how two organs work together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the new skin cells to the body felt somewhat repetitive after creating them; the result did clarify that older cells are shed.

surprise.text: The kidney-to-marrow signal was the most interesting link; it showed how red-cell production can respond to low oxygen delivery.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although most choices after the opening were the only offered combination, so I was following the route rather than discovering compatibility.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it developed more connections like the kidney-to-marrow signal, but the largely prescribed sequence gave me little reason to continue for the gameplay alone.
